corpus.name: Kitaita (Kidaw'ida) Bible, verses.jsonl supplied by the project owner
corpus.note: Published Bible translation: only aggregate counts are stored here.

cleaning: drop the leading verse number; drop cross-references (everything from " # " on); NFC + lowercase; apostrophes removed (tile decision 2026-10-26: ignore them); words = maximal runs of letters (hyphens, digits and punctuation split words). Proper names are not removed: there is no reliable way to tell them apart in sentence-initial position.
